recipes.title: Bagel and Lox Breakfast Board
recipes.subtitle: Toasted bagels with lox, cream cheese, capers, and fixings for ten.
recipes.description: Toasted bagels with lox, cream cheese, capers, and fixings laid out for self-serve. A lighter hall breakfast that still feels like a treat when the budget allows.

recipes.title: Bagel Sandwich Line
recipes.subtitle: Build-your-own bagel sandwiches with eggs, cheese, and proteins for staggered crews.
recipes.description: A firefighter hall breakfast line that lets every crew member build a hot bagel sandwich without waiting for individual orders. Egg sheets, cheese, and warm proteins stay organized in hotel pans so morning service continues even when the crew arrives in waves.

recipes.title: Baked Oatmeal with Mixed Berries
recipes.subtitle: Make-ahead baked oatmeal squares with berries for staggered eaters.
recipes.description: A 9x13 baked oatmeal that feeds the hall from one pan — quick oats baked with milk, eggs, and cinnamon, studded with mixed berries. Bake the night before or early shift; reheat portions in the microwave between calls.

recipes.title: BBQ Breakfast Hash
recipes.subtitle: Leftover BBQ pulled into a cast-iron hash with eggs on top.
recipes.description: Pulled pork or brisket folded into crispy potato hash with eggs cracked on top. Leftover BBQ becomes a breakfast the crew votes for — extra sauce on the side.

recipes.title: Belgian Waffle Platter
recipes.subtitle: Crisp yeasted waffles with whipped butter, syrup, and fresh berries.
recipes.description: Crisp Belgian waffles stacked on a platter with butter and syrup. Griddle in batches, hold warm, and let the crew build their own plate.

recipes.title: Biscuit French Toast Sliders
recipes.subtitle: Buttermilk biscuits dipped in custard, griddled, and glazed with syrup butter.
recipes.description: Buttermilk biscuits dipped in custard, baked golden, and sandwiched with sausage and maple glaze. Handheld, sweet-savory, and built for a tray on the table.

recipes.title: Breakfast Crunchwraps
recipes.subtitle: Griddled tortilla bundles with eggs, hash, and a crunchy tostada center.
recipes.description: Griddled wraps with eggs, sausage, hash, and cheese folded tight so nothing falls out on the way to the couch. Batch-build and hold under foil.

recipes.title: Breakfast Enchiladas for the Crew
recipes.subtitle: Rolled tortillas stuffed with eggs and chorizo under green chili sauce.
recipes.description: Corn tortillas rolled with scrambled eggs and sausage, smothered in enchilada sauce and cheese, baked until bubbling. Cut squares from a casserole dish — pure hall comfort.

recipes.title: Breakfast Fried Rice for the Crew
recipes.subtitle: Day-old rice wok-fried with bacon, eggs, peas, and scallions.
recipes.description: Day-old rice, bacon, eggs, and soy in a wok or flat-top — fast, salty, and perfect for using up leftovers after a big dinner cook.

recipes.title: Breakfast Nachos Supreme
recipes.subtitle: Tortilla chips loaded with eggs, bacon, cheese, and salsa on sheet pans.
recipes.description: Tortilla chips loaded with scrambled eggs, sausage, cheese, and salsa on a sheet pan. Messy in the best way — serve with hot sauce and let the crew dig in.

recipes.title: Breakfast Poutine
recipes.subtitle: Crispy fries under peppery gravy, cheese curds, and fried eggs.
recipes.description: Crispy fries, rich gravy, cheese curds, and a fried egg on top. Canadian firehall comfort that hits after an overnight.

recipes.title: Breakfast Quesadillas
recipes.subtitle: Crisp flour tortillas packed with eggs, bacon, and pepper jack.
recipes.description: Flour tortillas stuffed with eggs, cheese, and peppers, griddled crisp and cut into wedges. Stack on a tray and serve with salsa and sour cream.

recipes.title: Breakfast Sandwich Trays
recipes.subtitle: English muffins, sausage, eggs, and cheese for ten.
recipes.description: English muffins toasted, sausage cooked, eggs scrambled — assemble a full tray of breakfast sandwiches so ten people eat at once without waiting on one griddle.

recipes.title: Breakfast Sliders
recipes.subtitle: Mini sandwiches with sausage, egg, and maple glaze baked on one tray.
recipes.description: Mini brioche buns with sausage, egg, and cheese — slider format for crews who want variety without cooking ten different things.

recipes.title: Breakfast Stromboli Roll
recipes.subtitle: Pizza dough rolled with scrambled eggs, ham, and cheese, baked golden.
recipes.description: Pizza dough rolled with scrambled eggs, ham, and cheese, baked golden and sliced into rings. One big roll feeds the hall and reheats clean.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Pancakes for the Crew
recipes.subtitle: Fluffy griddle pancakes stacked for a hungry crew.
recipes.description: Fluffy buttermilk pancakes from a big batch of batter — griddle in waves, stack on sheet pans in a warm oven, and pass the syrup.

recipes.title: Cast Iron Breakfast Skillet
recipes.subtitle: Potatoes, sausage, and eggs with crispy cast-iron edges.
recipes.description: Potatoes par-cooked then crisped in cast iron with sausage, onions, and eggs cracked on top under a lid. The skillet breakfast every hall knows.

recipes.title: Chicken and Waffles for the Crew
recipes.subtitle: Crispy buttermilk fried chicken on Belgian waffles with maple butter.
recipes.description: Crispy chicken tenders with Belgian waffles on a platter — sweet, salty, and big enough for a crew that earned a splurge breakfast.

recipes.title: Chilaquiles Verde Bake
recipes.subtitle: Tortilla chips baked in green salsa with eggs, crema, and cotija.
recipes.description: Tortilla chips baked in green salsa with eggs and cheese — Mexican breakfast casserole style that feeds ten from one pan.

recipes.title: Chorizo Breakfast Hash
recipes.subtitle: Spicy crumbled chorizo with crispy potatoes and jammy eggs.
recipes.description: Chorizo, potatoes, and eggs in cast iron with a hit of cumin and paprika. Crispy edges, runny yolks optional, serve straight from the pan.

recipes.title: Club Sandwich Breakfast Bake
recipes.subtitle: Layered bread, turkey, bacon, tomato, and eggs baked like a strata.
recipes.description: Layers of bread, turkey, bacon, tomato, and egg custard baked like a strata. Slice into squares — club sandwich energy without stacking ten sandwiches by hand.

recipes.title: Corned Beef Hash Breakfast
recipes.subtitle: Crisp diced potatoes and corned beef with eggs cracked on top.
recipes.description: Corned beef and potatoes crisped in a skillet with eggs on top. Diner classic scaled for the firehall — especially good after St. Patrick's or leftover corned beef.

recipes.title: Country Fried Steak and Eggs Breakfast
recipes.subtitle: Pounded cube steak, pepper gravy, and eggs over mashed potatoes.
recipes.description: Crispy country-fried steak with gravy, eggs, and hash browns on a platter. A heavy breakfast for days off or when the crew needs real comfort food.

recipes.title: Cowboy Breakfast Skillet
recipes.subtitle: Smoky beans, crispy potatoes, and eggs in one cast-iron pan.
recipes.description: Black beans, peppers, potatoes, and eggs with cheddar in cast iron — Southwest cowboy breakfast that fills the hall.

recipes.title: Crew French Toast Bake
recipes.subtitle: Cinnamon French toast baked in a 9x13 for clean slices.
recipes.description: Day-old bread soaked in cinnamon custard, baked in a 9x13, and sliced into squares. Maple syrup on the side — easier than standing at the griddle for an hour.

recipes.title: Denver Breakfast Casserole
recipes.subtitle: Ham, bell peppers, and onion baked into a make-ahead egg strata.
recipes.description: Ham, bell peppers, onion, and cheddar baked with eggs — the Denver omelette in casserole form for ten hungry firefighters.

recipes.title: Eggs Benedict Hall Style
recipes.subtitle: Poached eggs, Canadian bacon, and hollandaise on toasted English muffins.
recipes.description: Poached eggs, Canadian bacon, and hollandaise on English muffins — hall-style benedict with a workflow that doesn't stall the whole kitchen.

recipes.title: Farmer's Breakfast Casserole
recipes.subtitle: Hash browns, sausage, eggs, and cheese baked in one deep dish.
recipes.description: Sausage, hash browns, and cheese under a blanket of eggs in a deep pan. The farmhouse breakfast casserole every crew recognizes.

recipes.title: Fire Captain Omelette Bar
recipes.subtitle: Made-to-order omelettes with a prep line of fillings for ten.
recipes.description: Set up an omelette bar with beaten eggs, diced ham, peppers, cheese, and hot sauce. Everyone builds their own — lighter option that still feels like a real hall cook.

recipes.title: Firehall Breakfast Pizza
recipes.subtitle: Sheet-pan pizza loaded with scrambled eggs, sausage, and melty cheese.
recipes.description: Breakfast pizza on a sheet pan — eggs, sausage, cheese, and hash browns on dough. Cut squares, serve from the middle of the table, done.

recipes.title: German Potato Breakfast Skillet
recipes.subtitle: Pan-fried potatoes with bratwurst, sauerkraut, and fried eggs.
recipes.description: German-style fried potatoes with bacon and eggs in one pan. Simple, crispy, and exactly what you'd expect on a European-influenced hall menu.

recipes.title: Green Chile Breakfast Burritos
recipes.subtitle: Flour tortillas stuffed with eggs, potatoes, bacon, and Hatch chile sauce.
recipes.description: Green chile, potatoes, eggs, and cheese in flour tortillas — Southwest hall breakfast with real heat.

recipes.title: Hall Breakfast Burritos
recipes.subtitle: Big-batch burritos that hold warm between waves of eaters.
recipes.description: The standard hall burrito line: potatoes, sausage, eggs, and cheese in warm tortillas. Batch-build, hold warm, feed staggered eaters without remaking plates.

recipes.title: Hall Breakfast Wraps
recipes.subtitle: Soft flour wraps rolled with eggs, turkey sausage, and spinach.
recipes.description: Flour wraps with scrambled eggs, turkey sausage, spinach, and cheese — lighter than a burrito but still handheld and line-friendly.

recipes.title: Hall Sausage Biscuits & Gravy
recipes.subtitle: Flaky biscuits split and smothered in peppery sausage gravy for twelve.
recipes.description: Flaky biscuits split open and smothered in peppery sausage gravy. A firehall classic that needs no introduction — make extra gravy.

recipes.title: Hash Brown Breakfast Casserole
recipes.subtitle: A cheese, egg, hash brown, and breakfast meat bake that holds for late eaters.
recipes.description: This hall-ready hash brown breakfast casserole layers crisp-edged potatoes, eggs, cheese, and breakfast meat in a deep pan. It is built for firefighter crews whose morning meal may be interrupted, because clean squares hold better than made-to-order eggs.

recipes.title: Huevos Rancheros for the Crew
recipes.subtitle: Crisp tortillas, ranchero sauce, and sunny eggs for a full hall.
recipes.description: Corn tortillas, fried eggs, ranchero sauce, and beans on a platter — Mexican breakfast classic scaled for ten with cilantro and lime on the side.

recipes.title: Irish Breakfast Fry-Up
recipes.subtitle: Bacon, sausage, black pudding, eggs, and soda bread on one plate.
recipes.description: Bacon, sausage, eggs, beans, tomatoes, and toast on a full English-Irish spread. Weekend breakfast when the hall has time to cook everything at once.

recipes.title: Johnnycakes with Maple Syrup
recipes.subtitle: Rhode Island cornmeal griddle cakes with butter and warm syrup.
recipes.description: Cornmeal johnnycakes griddled golden and stacked with butter and maple syrup. Old-school Northeast hall breakfast — simple and satisfying.

recipes.title: Lumberjack Breakfast Platter
recipes.subtitle: Pancakes, eggs, bacon, sausage, and hash browns for a hungry crew.
recipes.description: Eggs, bacon, sausage, pancakes, and hash browns on one big platter. The lumberjack spread for crews with big appetites after a long night.

recipes.title: Maple Sausage Pinwheels
recipes.subtitle: Crescent dough spirals with sausage and maple glaze baked golden.
recipes.description: Puff pastry spirals with maple sausage and cheese, baked and sliced into rounds. Sweet-savory handhelds that disappear fast from the tray.

recipes.title: Menemen for the Crew
recipes.subtitle: Turkish-style soft scrambled eggs with tomatoes, peppers, and olive oil.
recipes.description: Soft-scrambled eggs folded into a slow-cooked tomato-pepper base with plenty of olive oil — a skillet breakfast that scales cleanly and tastes great with warm pita or bread from the oven.

recipes.title: Migas for the Crew
recipes.subtitle: Scrambled eggs with crispy tortilla strips, peppers, and queso fresco.
recipes.description: Crispy tortilla strips scrambled with eggs, peppers, and cheese — Texas migas scaled for the whole hall with salsa on the side.

recipes.title: Monte Cristo Sandwiches
recipes.subtitle: Ham and turkey dipped in egg batter, griddled, and dusted with powdered sugar.
recipes.description: Ham and cheese sandwiches dipped in egg batter, griddled golden, dusted with powdered sugar. Serve with jam — sweet-savory hall brunch energy.

recipes.title: Overnight French Toast Bake
recipes.subtitle: Prep tonight, bake tomorrow—a custard-soaked tray for the whole crew.
recipes.description: Assemble the night before, bake in the morning — custard-soaked bread with cinnamon that feeds ten without anyone standing at the stove at 0600.

recipes.title: Overnight Oat Bar for the Crew
recipes.subtitle: Scoop-and-go overnight oats with toppings for a staggered morning hall service.
recipes.description: This firefighter breakfast oat bar is assembled the night before, then set out as a scoop-and-go station with fruit, nuts, and nut butter. It is ideal for a hall crew that needs a filling morning option without turning on the stove after a late call.

recipes.title: Overnight Sausage Strata
recipes.subtitle: Make-ahead bread, sausage, and egg bake rested overnight and baked hot.
recipes.description: Sausage, bread, and cheese layered overnight with egg custard, baked until puffed and golden. Make-ahead hall breakfast for early shift change.

recipes.title: Quick Egg Tacos
recipes.subtitle: Fast egg tacos when the crew needs food in fifteen minutes.
recipes.description: Scrambled eggs, cheese, and salsa in warm tortillas — fifteen-minute breakfast when the tones drop and the crew still needs to eat.

recipes.title: Red Lead Skillet
recipes.subtitle: Senior cook specialty—steak, peppers, and eggs in one cast-iron pan.
recipes.description: The official Red Lead sauce folded into a breakfast hash with potatoes, sausage, and eggs. Station signature flavor — crew-approved and hall-authentic.

recipes.title: Sausage Egg & Cheese Sandwiches
recipes.subtitle: Classic sausage, egg, and cheese on toasted buns.
recipes.description: Sausage patty, folded egg, and melted cheese on a toasted bun — the breakfast sandwich every firefighter knows. Batch on a griddle and wrap in foil for the line.

recipes.title: Scrapple and Eggs Skillet
recipes.subtitle: Crisp Pennsylvania scrapple slices with fried eggs and toast points.
recipes.description: Mid-Atlantic scrapple crisped in cast iron with eggs on top. Regional hall classic for crews who grew up on it.

recipes.title: Shakshuka for the Hall
recipes.subtitle: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato-pepper skillet for the whole crew.
recipes.description: A one-pan hall breakfast: onions and peppers simmer in a thick tomato sauce, then eggs poach right in the skillet so every firefighter gets runny yolks and warm sauce for bread. Sauce can be made ahead and reheated before the eggs go in.

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Breakfast Hash
recipes.subtitle: Sheet-pan hash with eggs cracked over the top.
recipes.description: Potatoes, sausage, and peppers roasted on a sheet pan with eggs cracked over the top in the oven. One pan, easy cleanup, feeds ten.

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Breakfast Sandwiches
recipes.subtitle: A dozen eggs and cheese baked between two layers of slider rolls.
recipes.description: Eggs baked on a sheet pan, cut into squares, and layered on toasted buns with sausage and cheese. Ten sandwiches without flipping eggs one at a time.

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Full English
recipes.subtitle: English breakfast components roasted and finished on one pan.
recipes.description: Bacon, sausage, tomatoes, mushrooms, and eggs roasted on sheet pans — full English breakfast without ten pans on the stove.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Eggs & Sausage
recipes.subtitle: Roasted peppers, browned sausage, and baked eggs for a 8–10 person hall breakfast.
recipes.description: This firefighter-friendly sheet-pan breakfast roasts peppers and onions beside browned sausage, then bakes eggs right on top. It gives the hall a hot, hearty tray with a short service window and no griddle traffic.

recipes.title: Shrimp and Grits Breakfast
recipes.subtitle: Creamy stone-ground grits topped with Cajun-spiced shrimp and andouille.
recipes.description: Creamy grits with sautéed shrimp and andouille — coastal hall breakfast that feels special without being fussy.

recipes.title: Smoked Salmon Benedict
recipes.subtitle: Poached eggs and hollandaise over smoked salmon and rye toast.
recipes.description: Poached eggs and smoked salmon with hollandaise on English muffins — lighter benedict for crews who want fish instead of Canadian bacon.

recipes.title: Southwest Egg Bake
recipes.subtitle: Peppers, salsa, and pepper jack in a crew-sized egg bake.
recipes.description: Pepper jack, salsa, and bell peppers baked into a Southwest egg casserole — slice, serve, and pass the hot sauce.

recipes.title: Tater Tot Breakfast Casserole
recipes.subtitle: Crispy tater tots baked with eggs, bacon, and melty cheese.
recipes.description: Tater tots, sausage, and cheese under baked eggs — tater tot hot dish meets breakfast casserole. Crowd-pleaser every time.

recipes.title: Turkey Sausage Breakfast Burritos
recipes.subtitle: Leaner burritos that still feel like a real hall breakfast.
recipes.description: Turkey sausage, potatoes, and eggs in warm tortillas — leaner burritos that still taste like a real hall breakfast, not diet food.

recipes.title: Veggie Egg Burritos
recipes.subtitle: Peppers, spinach, and eggs wrapped for the vegetarian on shift.
recipes.description: Peppers, spinach, and scrambled eggs in flour tortillas — vegetarian option that still feeds the line with real flavor and hot sauce.
